topic: Testing New Reach for NZ campaign data
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on testing the 'New Reach' feature for a specific case in New Zealand, particularly one involving a high volume of frames. [p3] provided location details (7972,[redacted],Phantom Billstickers,New Zealand,Auckland). After deployment confirmation, [me] inquired whether 'New Reach' is limited to campaign views or if it can also be applied within standard dashboards. [p2] clarified that it is intended only for campaigns.
decisions: The New Reach feature was deployed/connected for the specified New Zealand location.
